grammar_patterns.pattern: Can I use your [noun]? Yes, you can. / No, you can't.
examples: Can I use your computer? Yes, you can.
Can I use your camera? No, you can't.
Can we turn on the TV? No, you can't.
Can you turn off the DVD player, please?
Can you turn on the TV, please?
Amy, can you turn on the TV, please?
Can you open the window, please?
Can you help me with my homework, please?
Can you close the door, please?

grammar_patterns.pattern: I have a collection of [plural noun].
examples: I have a collection of soccer stickers.
I have a great collection of pins.
He has a shell collection.
I have 60 stickers.
I have 50 pins.
He has one hundred shells.

phonics.description: Words with the ar sound, as in car.

key_sentences: Amy, can you turn on the TV, please?
Can I use your computer? Yes, you can.
Is this your computer? Yes, it's your computer.
Can you turn off the DVD player, please?
I love soccer and I have a collection of soccer stickers.
I have 60 stickers and they're in a special sticker book.
Does Jon have a collection? Yes, he does. He has a shell collection.
How many shells does he have? He has one hundred shells.
